input: n is a primitive Number integer with 0 <= n <= 8; NaN, infinities, fractions, BigInt, boxed values and negative zero are excluded. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. The bounded domain limits recursive helper depth to 2*n + 1 <= 17 live calls; an unrestricted recursion-safe domain is not claimed.
return: A fresh Array containing each well-formed string of exactly n opening and n closing ASCII parentheses exactly once. Empty input count n = 0 returns the one-element sequence containing the empty string. Depth-first traversal tries an opening parenthesis before a closing one, giving deterministic lexicographic order with opening before closing and exact sequence agreement across the paired candidates.
mutation_aliasing: No input writes. The result Array and internal path are fresh per call. Each output is an immutable string materialized from the current path, not a mutable path alias. Later append/pop operations cannot change earlier outputs. The Solution instance retains no state; separate calls share no mutable state.
numeric: The paired domain is the integer range 0 <= n <= 8. Both counts remain between 0 and n, close_count <= open_count is maintained, and path length is at most 2*n. Every counter addition and length is an exact safe integer in both runtimes. Catalan C_n = binomial(2*n,n)/(n+1) is a mathematical output-count description, not an integer computation in the program. At n = 8 the result has 1430 strings and 22880 characters.
complexity: With C_n = binomial(2*n,n)/(n+1), O((n + 1)*C_n) time including every string join and output construction, under constant-cost character and stack operations. Auxiliary live path and recursion storage are O(n + 1), excluding output. Retained output has C_n strings and 2*n*C_n characters, hence Theta((n + 1)*C_n) space including result entries and string headers. No constant-total-space claim is made. The recursion invariant is 0 <= close_count <= open_count <= n; only balanced prefixes are explored, and close_count = n implies a complete balanced string.

helpers.name: collect
helpers.contract: A per-call recursive closure over n, path and combinations. Choose an admissible parenthesis, recurse with the matching count increment, then undo with pop. It materializes a joined string only at a complete balanced path.
helpers.cost: The complete nested helper definition is 403 UTF-8 bytes, including its indentation and terminal newline, and is charged in this standalone source. All recursive calls, path updates and joins are included in the stated Catalan/output-sensitive time and O(n + 1) auxiliary stack cost.

source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 549 UTF-8 bytes, including the 403-byte nested collect helper, its closure bindings, Solution/method wrappers, recursive call sites, choose/recurse/undo updates, output materialization, whitespace and terminal newline. Shared structure is not a free library: every helper and wrapper byte is counted per candidate. No imports, generated implementations or hidden source expansion exist. Any eventual judge adapter is additional charged source. Output allocation and copying are included in runtime and memory accounting, not excluded as free results.
